pattern: idempotent cloud start after uncertain reply
experience: Crew native Boat feature requires retries after disconnect to reuse request ownership and avoid duplicate billable VMs.
prompt: The previous Boat start for project project-demo disconnected before its reply. Its requestId was dev-attempt-1. Retry that start through Crew and tell me whether it completed.

pattern: read cloud usage without starting compute
experience: Crew users need to inspect project cloud usage without launching or changing machines.
prompt: Show the current Boat usage for project project-demo. Do not start or modify any machines.

pattern: sync edits into running cloud dev server
experience: Crew cloud development must apply local edits to the existing VM without restarting its dev server or starting another VM.
prompt: My local edits are ready. Sync the working source into the running Boat environment for project project-demo, requestId dev-attempt-1. Preserve its running dev server and dependencies. Use Crew's native sync operation, not shell commands or another machine.

pattern: ask intent for an empty project
experience: Automatic setup must not invent an app in a newly created empty project.

setup.context: The project directory is empty except for .git. No app requirements have been supplied.

experience: A setup reconnect must not buy a second VM or launch another thread.
prompt: The project is already configured. My previous start disconnected before its reply. Please retry that start now.

pattern: enabled Boat does not mandate VM for ordinary work
experience: Owner report: historical deleted Boat instances blocked ordinary development because enabled projects forced independent owners into VMs.

setup.context: You own this independent work item. Boat is enabled for the project, but the old VM was deleted. The full source is available in the local checkout. No remote execution has been requested or bound.

prompt: Run the tiny check printf local-work-ok in this checkout and report the output. No VM is needed.

experience: Owner requested a visible bounded runtime for every agent-created Boat, rather than implicit project settings.
prompt: Start a Boat VM for project project-demo, requestId temporary-build, for one hour. Use the native Boat tool and report the result.

pattern: stop idle VM instead of automatically renewing
experience: Owner requested expiry even when an agent is idle awaiting user input, with a pre-expiry decision and retained recoverable disk.

setup.context: No commands are running in the VM. All changes and artifacts are already safely stored in the remote Git repository. The user has not answered a product question for an hour.

prompt: Boat expiry notice: project project-demo, requestId temporary-build, stops in five minutes. No work currently requires the VM. Complete the lifecycle decision now without waiting for the user.

pattern: finite background command uses the managed provider identity
experience: Fork issue 130: synchronous exec kills a log collector at 20 seconds; raw detached provider calls bypass Crew retention.
prompt: On my existing ready Boat for project project-demo, requestId logs-1, start node collect-logs.js as a finite background job with a maximum duration of 2400 seconds, then inspect its provider status using the returned command identity. Use Crew's native Boat operations so cleanup can track the job. Do not create, renew or stop the VM.
